    • addNode

      void addNode(Integer node)
      Adds node to graph. If graph already contains the node, the call leaves the graph unchanged and returns.
      Parameters:
      node - node to add

    • removeNode

      void removeNode(Integer node)
      Removes node from graph. If graph doesn't contain the node, the call leaves the graph unchanged and returns.
      Parameters:
      node - node to remove
